```sql
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.year = 2010 THEN res.points ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.year = 2009 THEN res.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS point_difference
FROM main.results res
JOIN main.races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN main.drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
  AND r.year IN (2009, 2010)
```
